method: Inspect committed file references and file existence. Launchers and Docker were not executed.

findings.title: Development requirements reference moved files
findings.expected: All recursive requirements paths resolve from a clean checkout.
findings.retest: Resolve requirements-dev.txt recursively, then install in a fresh disposable venv.

findings.title: Launchers reference removed compose and graph CLI paths
findings.actual: data/compose.yaml is absent; canonical compose is dataPreprocessing/compose.yaml. local-data.ps1 also calls removed data/knowledge_graph.py.
findings.expected: Fresh sample and full launch paths resolve before Docker or model operations.
findings.retest: Validate both compose files with docker compose config, then start Sample and Full in disposable volumes. Verify import and read-only parity.

findings.title: Data API and bootstrap import the former package namespace
findings.actual: Old data.core, data.service, data.graph and data.storage imports reference moved modules. Python test collection reproduces ModuleNotFoundError: data.core.
findings.expected: Data services and bootstrap import the current dataPreprocessing package. The untouched commit collects its tests.
findings.retest: Run pytest dataPreprocessing/tests tests/test_api.py tests/test_webhook_gateway.py in a clean test environment. Import entry points, then exercise /ready, capabilities and complete listing scans.
